message: 原Astra实际单次诊断正式验收已到：C0/I0/M0 PASSED，root结合5945e7独核采纳。报告固定diagnostic-report.json136151B/SHA ef1271dfa71a9c9716fb4801fd4279209e9ae4dfe808459c3019845be92a0d40；最终guard SHA715f604de0029670e213bf808f20a9b18184d303257d273142003cc5dd119f25。可验收A fixture真实L1链已到676断言、B本次official-fail路径的隔离/记录/stop/quiet/限定恢复；official1/L1fail不能写通过。独立raw stdout/mocha/events/meta1/L1fail/10hooks、sourceMap676、双observedPane+Reveal(1130loaded/10038manifest-only)、grant先intent且deadline内、journal1intent+1complete、25PIDquiet、12guards+5poststage/live均核。无C/I/M。限制：failedbody跳computeLeakingDisposables不能称leakfree；保护边界采样不称所有syscall隔离/全异常注入；不追授业务oldred/newgreen/fullReveal/after。旧8033 official1/whole.buildFAILED和v1/v2失败保留。下一步不用重复此诊断，另新业务包固定新native恢复基准，精确a4a旧生产L1业务red→固定新13+完整Reveal→非作者真实默认编辑器after；新Pane发射、old/new切换、phase/testselection/restorescope/判定扩展均semantic工具变更须sourcepeer+wholepeer，不得仅manifest改动沿用旧授权。本报告为root转述原Astra directFINAL摘要，不伪称逐字raw。出版inventory已收，随后我发具体落仓commit授权。
